data.reason: Slice 1 regression (record 12) failed for two causes the slice plan did not anticipate: vitest projects ignore --dir, so test:unit now also runs packages/core/db tests (and Stryker's vitest.dir may not restrict the product run to src); and db/authorities.test.ts refuses the fixture's @fast-check/vitest import because IMPORTS_THAT_CANNOT_READ in packages/core/db/repository.ts does not list it. The fix needs packages/core/db/repository.ts, which no slice names, and slice 1's files are now refused by the guard. Amend slice 1 to name repository.ts and split vitest into unit, db and fixtures projects selected by name.
